page.layout: One page of running text, full width, no margin notes. Running head at top, page number at top. Catchword at lower right.

main_text.p: quæ in Croatia & Sclavonia cuncta ferro & i-gni vastaverat, solius ipsius auspiciis, ac aliorum ope nequicquam implorata, inde ejecta.
main_text.head: FOEDUS CUM ALEXANDRO VI. Pontifice maximo, Senatu Veneto, ac Ludo-vico Sforzia initum, quo mediante Carolus VIII. Gallorum rex, regnum Neapolitanum, à se subjugatum, deferere ac domum redire coactus.
DUCTA IN MATRIMONIUM BLAN-ca Maria, Principis Mediolani filia, receptoq; à Lud. Sforzia fidei juramento, Ducatus Mediolani ad Imperii obedientiam sine sanguine re-ductus.
CONCILIATIS INTER FILIUM SU-um Philippum, ac inclytorum regum Ferdi-nandi & Elisabethę filiam Ioannam nuptiis, ad amplissimorum Hispaniæ regnorum successionem aditus posteris ipsius apertus.
BOHEMI, QUI SORORIUM IPSIUS Albertum Bavariæ Ducem mercede conducti oppugnatum advenerant, memorabili prælio prope urbem Ratisponam, plurimis illorum interfectis, superati.

page.notes: Catchword "KVEF-" is partly cut off at the edge; reading uncertain. Small marks and ink specks below the text are not printed text and were left out. Ligature and abbreviation forms (quæ, s, q;) follow the scan. The text "Elisabethę" has a doubtful final letter. The heading lines are set in capitals and small capitals on their own line, so they are marked as level 3 headings, while the bare numerals X., XI., XII., XIII. are paragraphs. Capital V in words such as FILIVM, IPSIVS, QVI, DVCTA was read as the vowel U.
